# setup

Longitudinal flow-cytometry phenotyping of PBLs: PD-1 levels and activation/differentiation markers in
CD4+ and CD8+ lymphocytes across the sampled timepoints.

`setup/setup.R` is not sourced here: it configures the Python/MAGIC environment needed by the single-cell
scripts only. Paths are defined the same way.

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggforce)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)
  library(patchwork)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
})
setup_dir <- normalizePath("../setup", mustWork = TRUE)
project_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(setup_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
flow_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "resources", "flow-phenotype")
results_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "results", "long-tracking", "phenotype")
source(file.path(setup_dir, "functions-flow-phenotype.R"))
# --- Figures were drawn with Arial; default sans font where it is missing ---
plot_font <- if ("Arial" %in% systemfonts::system_fonts()$family) "Arial" else ""
```

# load

```{r}
pd1.levels <- read.csv(file.path(flow_dir, "VHIO136-PD1-cat.csv"), sep = ";", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
panel.1 <- read.csv(file.path(flow_dir, "VHIO136-CD4-CD8-panel1.csv"), sep = ";", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
panel.2 <- read.csv(file.path(flow_dir, "VHIO136-CD4-CD8-panel2.csv"), sep = ";", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
data <- rbind(panel.1, panel.2)
data.cd4 <- data %>% filter(CD4_CD8 == "CD4")
data.cd8 <- data %>% filter(CD4_CD8 == "CD8")
pheno_days <- c(0, 14, 42, 56, 84, 112, 140)
vline_df <- data.frame(day = pheno_days)
theme_manuscript <- theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = plot_font) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = plot_font),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 0.5
  )
pd1_labels_counts <- c(
  "PD1_hi" = "PD-1 hi",
  "PD1_int" = "PD-1 int",
  "PD1_neg" = "PD-1 neg"
)
pd1_labels_flow <- c(
  "PD1hi" = "PD-1 hi",
  "PD1int" = "PD-1 int",
  "PD1neg" = "PD-1 neg"
)
plots_list <- list()
```

# pheno

Calculate the fraction of each PD1 category within the total marker-positive population. For example, among all CD27+ cells, what proportion are PD1hi, PD1int, or PD1neg?

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
day_vec <- c(14, 42, 56, 84, 112, 140, 0)
CD4pan1 <- read_panel("VHIO136-reanalysis-CD4pan1.csv", day_vec, "CD4", dir = flow_dir)
CD4pan2 <- read_panel("VHIO136-reanalysis-CD4pan2.csv", day_vec, "CD4", dir = flow_dir)
CD8pan1 <- read_panel("VHIO136-reanalysis-CD8pan1.csv", day_vec, "CD8", dir = flow_dir)
CD8pan2 <- read_panel("VHIO136-reanalysis-CD8pan2.csv", day_vec, "CD8", dir = flow_dir)
CD4pan1 <- rename_panel_base(CD4pan1, "CD4", 1)
CD4pan2 <- rename_panel_base(CD4pan2, "CD4", 2)
CD8pan1 <- rename_panel_base(CD8pan1, "CD8", 1)
CD8pan2 <- rename_panel_base(CD8pan2, "CD8", 2)
CD4_all <- left_join(CD4pan1, CD4pan2, by = "day")
CD8_all <- left_join(CD8pan1, CD8pan2, by = "day")
markers_all <- c("CD27", "CD28", "CD38", "CD39", "LAG3", "HLADR", "CCR7", "CD45RO", "FoxP3", "ICOS", "Ki67", "TIM3")
pd1_groups <- c("PD1hi", "PD1int", "PD1neg")
```

```{r}
CD4_prop_long <- CD4_all %>%
  compute_marker_props("CD4", pd1_groups, markers_all) %>%
  pivot_marker_props("CD4")
CD8_prop_long <- CD8_all %>%
  compute_marker_props("CD8", pd1_groups, markers_all) %>%
  pivot_marker_props("CD8")
```

# pd1

Longitudinal levels of PD1 levels (hi, int, low).

```{r}
pd1.levels_long_mean <- pd1.levels %>%
  mutate(PD1_pos = PD1_hi + PD1_int) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    c(PD1_neg, PD1_int, PD1_hi, PD1_pos),
    names_to = "pd1_level",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = mean(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_number = mean(total_number, na.rm = TRUE),
    PD1_pct = mean(n / total_number * 100, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(day, CD4_CD8, pd1_level)
  )
plot.pd1 <- pd1.levels_long_mean %>%
  filter(pd1_level %in% c("PD1_hi", "PD1_int", "PD1_neg")) %>%
  mutate(
    pd1_level = factor(pd1_level, levels = c("PD1_hi", "PD1_int", "PD1_neg"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(day, PD1_pct, colour = pd1_level, group = pd1_level)) +
  geom_vline(
    data = vline_df,
    aes(xintercept = day),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    colour = "grey85"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = pheno_days,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(0.1, 100),
    breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100),
    labels = c("0.1", "1", "10", "100"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))
  ) +
  scale_colour_discrete(
    breaks = names(pd1_labels_counts),
    labels = unname(pd1_labels_counts)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~CD4_CD8, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Frequency of lymphocytes (%)",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_manuscript
plots_list[["pd1_levels"]] <- plot.pd1
print(plots_list[["pd1_levels"]])
```

# cd4

```{r}
y_limits_cd4 <- data.cd4 %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  summarise(
    y_max = ceiling(max(lymphocyte_pc, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    day = min(data.cd4$day, na.rm = TRUE),
    lymphocyte_pc = y_max
  )
plot.cd4 <- data.cd4 %>%
  mutate(
    pd1_level = factor(pd1_level, levels = c("PD1_hi", "PD1_int", "PD1_neg"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_blank(
    data = y_limits_cd4,
    aes(x = day, y = lymphocyte_pc),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = vline_df,
    aes(xintercept = day),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    colour = "grey85"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(x = day, y = lymphocyte_pc, colour = pd1_level, group = pd1_level),
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = day, y = lymphocyte_pc, colour = pd1_level, group = pd1_level),
    size = 1.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ marker, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = pheno_days,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_colour_discrete(
    breaks = names(pd1_labels_counts),
    labels = unname(pd1_labels_counts)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Frequency of CD4+ lymphocytes (%)",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_manuscript
plots_list[["cd4_pd1_markers"]] <- plot.cd4
print(plots_list[["cd4_pd1_markers"]])
```

# cd8

```{r}
excluded_markers_cd8 <- c("FoxP3", "CD39", "DR", "CD38", "LAG3", "TIM3")
markers_cd8_remaining <- setdiff(
  if (is.factor(data.cd8$marker)) levels(data.cd8$marker) else unique(as.character(data.cd8$marker)),
  excluded_markers_cd8
)
data.cd8_remaining <- data.cd8 %>%
  filter(marker %in% markers_cd8_remaining) %>%
  mutate(
    marker = factor(as.character(marker), levels = markers_cd8_remaining)
  )
y_limits_cd8 <- data.cd8_remaining %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  summarise(
    y_max = ceiling(max(lymphocyte_pc, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10,
    .groups = "drop"

    pd1_level = factor(pd1_level, levels = c("PD1_hi", "PD1_int", "PD1_neg"))

  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = day, y = lymphocyte_pc, colour = pd1_level, group = pd1_level),
    size = 1.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ marker, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +

    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
```

# z-score variation

CD4+ and CD8+ lymphocyte z-score variation relative to day 0.

```{r}
markers.cd4 <- c("CD39", "DR", "ICOS", "LAG3", "TIM3")
plots_list[["cd4_zscore_markers"]] <- make_zscore_variation_plot(
  data.cd4 %>%
    filter(marker %in% markers.cd4) %>%
    mutate(marker = factor(marker, levels = markers.cd4)),
  subset_label = "CD4"
)
print(plots_list[["cd4_zscore_markers"]])
markers.cd8 <- c("CD39", "DR", "CD38", "LAG3", "TIM3")
plots_list[["cd8_zscore_markers"]] <- make_zscore_variation_plot(
  data.cd8 %>%
    filter(marker %in% markers.cd8) %>%
    mutate(marker = factor(marker, levels = markers.cd8)),
  subset_label = "CD8"
)
print(plots_list[["cd8_zscore_markers"]])
```

# save

```{r}
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (i in names(plots_list)) {
  outfile <- file.path(results_dir, paste0(i, ".pdf"))
  tryCatch({
    if (capabilities("cairo")) {
      grDevices::cairo_pdf(file = outfile, width = 12, height = 8)
    } else {
      grDevices::pdf(file = outfile, width = 12, height = 8)
    }
    print(plots_list[[i]])
    dev.off()
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error en plot: ", i)
    message("  ", e$message)
    if (dev.cur() != 1) {
      try(dev.off(), silent = TRUE)
    }
  })
}
```

```{r}
print("Plots saved successfully.")
```
